definitions.gloss: political world; political circles; the world of politics
definitions.explanation: The collective sphere of political activity, including politicians, parties, and the institutions of government. Used in news and commentary to refer to the political establishment.

examples.japanese: {政界|せいかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
{政界|せいかい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{引退|いんたい}→引退：01848_intai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表明|ひょうめい}→表明：14052_hyoumei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He announced his retirement from politics.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧スキャンダル⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{政界|せいかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{衝撃|しょうげき}→衝撃：08678_shougeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: The scandal sent shockwaves through the political world.

notes:
USAGE:
{政界|せいかい} is a formal term frequently used in news reporting. It follows the common 〜⟦{界|かい}→界：09651_kai⟧ (world/sphere) pattern used for professional domains.

RELATED 〜{界|かい} COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{財界|ざいかい}→財界：22340_zaikai⟧ (financial world / business circles)
- ⟦{官界|かんかい}→官界：24371_kankai⟧ (bureaucratic circles)
- {学界|がっかい} (academic world)
- ⟦{芸能界|げいのうかい}→芸能界：15094_geinoukai⟧ (entertainment industry)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {政界|せいかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to enter politics)
- {政界|せいかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引退|いんたい}→引退：01848_intai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to retire from politics)
- {政界|せいかい}⟦{再編|さいへん}→再編：07656_saihen⟧ (political realignment)
- {政界|せいかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{重鎮|じゅうちん} (political heavyweight)
